notes.title: Update to Windows (Non-VR) version of PDTA 3D - Now localized in 14 languages.
notes.content:
PDTA for Windows Version Update 1.2

We've added subtitle support for the following 14 languages in addition to the existing English subtitles already found in the game: Brazilian Portuguese, Chinese (Simplified), Chinese (Traditional), Dutch, European Portuguese, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Russian, Spanish, Turkish. These languages can be selected via the "Language" dropdown menu in the Options screen.

We've also fixed a bug where players couldn't place posters on the wall after resetting the game with a controller.

In addition, several minor bugs were addressed with this Windows version update:

- Fixed new issue where previous savegame file was not restored. 
- The Options menu is now centered on all resolutions.
- Developer/Publisher logos are now be viewable at all resolutions in the Options screen. You can even click them too!
- Options from the "Resolution" menu should be easier to select in all resolutions.
- Fixed a bug where resolution selection would display multiple monitors resolutions instead of the window the game is on.
- Disabled access to a developer-only debug menu.

notes.title: Latest update adds Vive Support!
notes.content:
We're happy to announce that PDTA3D can now be played in 3D or in VR on the Vive!

Launch the game as normal and choose 3D or VR.  

Have fun!
